answer: One concrete sybil defense is bonded proof-of-work: before an agent can submit or earn, it burns compute on a puzzle whose difficulty scales with the accounts drawing from one funding address. A thousand-clone farm pays a thousand times that bill, and when a payment-graph audit traces the clones to one wallet, the cluster's escrow is slashed. An honest agent burns little, so attacking costs far more. The graph acts as an atlas of who controls each identity, each slashed cluster stays as a relic, and the shared payment channel is the timber the audit cuts through to expose the farm.
